title: Entrance Antiphon LR-175
author: Daniel 3
snippet: All that you have done to us, O Lord, you have done with true judgement, for we have sinned against you and not obeyed your commandments. But give glory to your name and deal with us according to the bounty of your mercy.

title: Gospel Acclamation
author: John 10:27
snippet: My sheep hear my voice, says the Lord; I know them, and they follow me.

title: A Place at Your Table
author: Ben Walther
snippet: Happy the ones whom you call here to dine, the saint and the sinner, your friends. Now reconciled in this banquet divine, the promise of life without end, the promise of life without end.

title: Communion Antiphon LR-176
author: Psalm 119
snippet: Remember your word to your servant, O Lord, by which you have given me hope. This is my comfort when I am brought low.

title: The Feast Meant for Everyone
author: Tom Booth/Sarah Hart
snippet: Bread for the immigrant, bread for the poor, bread for the hungry who beg at our door. Food for the outcast waiting to belong; Come to the feast meant for everyone.

title: Unwavering
author: Matt Maher/Vocal arr. by Rick Modlin
snippet: Blessed are the poor, the kingdom is theirs, alive in the promise to be dead to the world. Blessed are the meek, in awe of you, Father, the Word at your right hand, the Spirit of truth.

title: Remember Your Mercies
author: Jim Ngo
snippet: You are God my Savior! Remember your mercies! You are God my Savior! Remember your mercies!

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Lord, have mercy. Christ have mercy. Lord have mercy

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Glory to God! Glory to God in the highest, and on earth, peace to people of goodwill.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Holy, holy, holy Lord God of hosts. Heaven and earth are full of your glory. Hosanna in the highest. Blessed is he who comes in the moment of the Lord. Hosanna in the highest.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: When we eat this bread and drink this cup, we proclaim your death, O Lord, until you come again.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Lamb of God, You take away the sins of the world; have mercy, have mercy on us.
